description: Return The Watch, the field's forward calendar of pending events, scheduled hearings, regulatory sunsets, and condition-triggered milestones the observatory is tracking. Filter by status (pending / resolved / obsolete), horizon (imminent / near-term / structural), or scope (place / corridor / brief). Use to surface what the field is watching from any cognitive position.

brief.description: Optional: filter to items linked to a specific named-pattern brief.

corridor.description: Optional: filter to items scoped to a specific corridor (e.g., "us-27-south-lake").

horizon.description: Optional: filter to items in the named horizon band. Imminent = ≤14 days; near-term = ≤90 days; structural = >90 days or condition-triggered.

place.description: Optional: filter to items scoped to a specific place dossier (e.g., "leesburg-florida").

status.description: Filter by lifecycle status. Defaults to 'pending' (active watch items only); pass 'all' for the full corpus including resolved + obsolete entries.

name: list_watch_items
title: List Watch Items
